verdict.rationale: Qdrant's own deployment options let users control where data physically lives. Qdrant Private Cloud runs clusters in any Kubernetes cluster on any infrastructure, the Docker image persists data to a user-chosen local volume, and Qdrant Edge runs embedded with no network required. However, nothing in the evidence shows region selection for a managed cloud offering or any explicit data-residency guarantees, so residency is achieved through infrastructure choice rather than a documented region control. Missing for 10: documented managed-cloud region/residency selection, explicit data-residency or compliance commitments, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Qdrant Private Cloud allows you to manage Qdrant database clusters in any Kubernetes cluster on any infrastructure.
Qdrant Edge is a lightweight, embedded vector search engine for in-process retrieval — no background services, minimal memory footprint, and no network required.
